1.title: Trump Issues Tariffs on Key Ingredient for Electronics and Solar Panels
1.summary: The administration will impose a minimum import price for polysilicon, a key component for semiconductors and solar panels, as well as tariffs for products made with the material.

2.title: Watch: Nasa astronauts conduct 6.5-hour spacewalk outside ISS
2.summary: Astronauts Anil Menon and Jessica Meir ventured out to install a mounting hardware for the future addition of solar arrays to the space station.

3.title: Some House Republicans Are Backing a Challenger in Cory Mills’s Re-election Bid
3.summary: Two Republican lawmakers have endorsed a primary opponent of Representative Cory Mills, who has been accused of assault and is under investigation by the House Ethics Committee.

4.title: Israeli Settler Charged in Death of Activist Awdah Hathaleen
4.summary: The indictment was a rare case in which the Israeli authorities pressed charges against an Israeli in the killing of a Palestinian.

5.title: Fires Wrecked Their Village in France. Now They Want Answers.
5.summary: After fleeing France’s worst wildfire in decades, residents of Le Porge, a village west of Bordeaux, returned home 13 days later. They found a town in ruins.

6.title: Can Robots Save Japan’s Aging Cherry Blossom Farmers?
6.summary: Monster Wolf and Pochi are among the robots deployed to scare away bears and transport cherry blossoms in a northern region where many farmers are in their 70s or older.
